bio: Sahil Rihani is a Mortgage Agent Level 2 with DLC Keystone Financial Experts, serving Ontario and the GTA from a Mississauga office. The site stresses flexible mortgage structure, penalties and long-term cost over the headline rate. He works with first-time and move-up buyers, refinancers, self-employed and commissioned professionals and investors. Process: discovery call, application and document review, budget and planning call, ongoing check-ins.
